title: Canada cannot afford to leave talent on the sidelines - The Hill Times
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Canada cannot afford to leave talent on the sidelines - The Hill Times

Accessibility is not a compliance exercise or a cost to manage. It is an investment in Canada's productive capacity. Employers who track skills use, retention, and performance start to see accessibility not as a line item but as workforce intelligence.

Actual Article Body:
As Canada confronts economic uncertainty, changing demographics, and a rapidly transforming world of work, one question should be central to our economic strategy: are we making full use of the talent already here?
